-- ============================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION verify_audit_chain(check_tenant UUID DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE(
    is_valid BOOLEAN,
    total_records BIGINT,
    broken_at UUID
) AS $$
DECLARE
    rec RECORD;
    expected_hash TEXT;
    prev_hash TEXT := 'GENESIS';
    total BIGINT := 0;
BEGIN
    FOR rec IN SELECT * FROM audit_logs 
               WHERE (check_tenant IS NULL OR tenant_id = check_tenant)
               ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, id ASC LOOP
        total := total + 1;
        IF rec.previous_hash != prev_hash THEN
            is_valid := false;
            total_records := total;
            broken_at := rec.id;
            RETURN NEXT;
            RETURN;
        END IF;
        prev_hash := rec.hash;
    END LOOP;
    
    is_valid := true;
    total_records := total;
    broken_at := NULL;
    RETURN NEXT;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

# MOTOR DE EVALUACIÓN
# ============================================================

class ComplianceEngine:
    """Motor de cumplimiento legal versionado y explicable."""

    def __init__(self, rules: list[ComplianceRule] | None = None):
        self.rules = rules or RULES

    def get_active_rules(
        self, jurisdiction: Jurisdiction, check_date: date
    ) -> list[ComplianceRule]:
        return [
            r
            for r in self.rules
            if r.jurisdiction in (jurisdiction, Jurisdiction.EU)
            and r.is_active_on(check_date)
        ]

    def evaluate_daily_rest(
        self,
        employee_id: str,
        shifts: list[Shift],
        rule: ComplianceRule,
        check_date: date,
    ) -> Optional[Violation]:
        """Evalúa descanso entre jornadas consecutivas."""
        min_hours = rule.parameters["min_rest_hours"]
        day_shifts = sorted(
            [s for s in shifts if s.start.date() <= check_date <= s.end.date()],
            key=lambda s: s.start,
        )

        for i in range(len(day_shifts) - 1):
            current_end = day_shifts[i].end
            next_start = day_shifts[i + 1].start
            rest_hours = (next_start - current_end).total_seconds() / 3600

            if rest_hours < min_hours:
                return Violation(
                    rule_code=rule.rule_code,
                    rule_name=rule.name,
                    severity=rule.severity,
                    employee_id=employee_id,
                    violation_date=check_date,
                    computed_value=Decimal(str(round(rest_hours, 2))),
                    threshold_value=Decimal(str(min_hours)),
                    explanation=(
                        f"Descanso entre jornadas de {rest_hours:.1f}h, "
                        f"inferior al mínimo legal de {min_hours}h. "
                        f"Fin turno: {current_end.isoformat()}, "
                        f"Inicio siguiente: {next_start.isoformat()}."
                    ),
                    norm_name=rule.norm_name,
                    article_reference=rule.article_reference,
                    source_url=rule.source_url,
                    suggested_fix=(
                        f"Retrasar el inicio del siguiente turno al menos "
                        f"{min_hours - rest_hours:.1f}h más, o adelantar el fin "
                        f"del turno anterior."
                    ),
                    override_allowed=False,
                )
        return None

    def evaluate_weekly_hours(
        self,
        employee_id: str,
        shifts: list[Shift],
        rule: ComplianceRule,
        check_date: date,
    ) -> Optional[Violation]:
        """Evalúa horas semanales totales."""
        max_hours = rule.parameters["max_weekly_hours"]
        week_start = check_date - timedelta(days=check_date.weekday())
        week_end = week_start + timedelta(days=6)

        week_shifts = [
            s
            for s in shifts
            if s.start.date() >= week_start and s.start.date() <= week_end
        ]
        total_hours = sum(
            (s.end - s.start).total_seconds() / 3600 for s in week_shifts
        )

        if total_hours > max_hours:
            return Violation(
                rule_code=rule.rule_code,
                rule_name=rule.name,
                severity=rule.severity,
                employee_id=employee_id,
                violation_date=check_date,
                computed_value=Decimal(str(round(total_hours, 2))),
                threshold_value=Decimal(str(max_hours)),
                explanation=(
                    f"Total semanal de {total_hours:.1f}h, "
                    f"supera el máximo legal de {max_hours}h "
                    f"(semana {week_start.isoformat()} a {week_end.isoformat()})."
                ),
                norm_name=rule.norm_name,
                article_reference=rule.article_reference,
                source_url=rule.source_url,
                suggested_fix=(
                    f"Reducir {total_hours - max_hours:.1f}h de la planificación "
                    f"semanal o redistribuir turnos."
                ),
                override_allowed=False,
            )
        return None

    def evaluate_minor_daily_hours(
        self,
        employee_id: str,
        shifts: list[Shift],
        rule: ComplianceRule,
        check_date: date,
    ) -> Optional[Violation]:
        """Evalúa límite diario para menores."""
        max_hours = rule.parameters["max_daily_hours"]
        day_shifts = [
            s for s in shifts if s.start.date() == check_date and s.is_minor
        ]
        total_hours = sum(
            (s.end - s.start).total_seconds() / 3600 for s in day_shifts
        )

        if total_hours > max_hours:
            return Violation(
                rule_code=rule.rule_code,
                rule_name=rule.name,
                severity=rule.severity,
                employee_id=employee_id,
                violation_date=check_date,
                computed_value=Decimal(str(round(total_hours, 2))),
                threshold_value=Decimal(str(max_hours)),
                explanation=(
                    f"Trabajador menor con {total_hours:.1f}h en el día, "
                    f"supera el máximo de {max_hours}h para menores."
                ),
                norm_name=rule.norm_name,
                article_reference=rule.article_reference,
                source_url=rule.source_url,
                suggested_fix=f"Reducir la jornada del menor a máximo {max_hours}h.",
                override_allowed=False,
            )
        return None

    def evaluate_minor_night_work(
        self,
        employee_id: str,
        shifts: list[Shift],
        rule: ComplianceRule,
        check_date: date,
    ) -> Optional[Violation]:
        """Evalúa prohibición de trabajo nocturno para menores."""
        forbidden_start_hour = int(rule.parameters["forbidden_start"].split(":")[0])
        forbidden_end_hour = int(rule.parameters["forbidden_end"].split(":")[0])

        for s in shifts:
            if not s.is_minor or s.start.date() != check_date:
                continue
            start_hour = s.start.hour
            end_hour = s.end.hour

            if start_hour >= forbidden_start_hour or end_hour <= forbidden_end_hour:
                return Violation(
                    rule_code=rule.rule_code,
                    rule_name=rule.name,
                    severity=rule.severity,
                    employee_id=employee_id,
                    violation_date=check_date,
                    computed_value=Decimal(str(start_hour)),
                    threshold_value=Decimal(str(forbidden_start_hour)),
                    explanation=(
                        f"Turno de menor en horario nocturno "
                        f"({s.start.strftime('%H:%M')}-{s.end.strftime('%H:%M')}). "
                        f"Prohibido entre {forbidden_start_hour}:00 y "
                        f"{forbidden_end_hour}:00."
                    ),
                    norm_name=rule.norm_name,
                    article_reference=rule.article_reference,
                    source_url=rule.source_url,
                    suggested_fix="Reasignar el turno a horario diurno (06:00-22:00).",
                    override_allowed=False,
                )
        return None

    def evaluate_employee(
        self,
        employee_id: str,
        shifts: list[Shift],
        jurisdiction: Jurisdiction,
        check_date: date,
    ) -> ComplianceResult:
        """Evaluación completa de un empleado en una fecha."""
        result = ComplianceResult(
            employee_id=employee_id, check_date=check_date
        )
        active_rules = self.get_active_rules(jurisdiction, check_date)
        result.rules_evaluated = len(active_rules)

        for rule in active_rules:
            violation = None

            if "rest_hours" in rule.parameters and "daily" in rule.rule_code.lower():
                violation = self.evaluate_daily_rest(
                    employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date
                )
            elif "weekly_hours" in rule.parameters or "max_weekly" in rule.rule_code.lower():
                violation = self.evaluate_weekly_hours(
                    employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date
                )
            elif "minor" in rule.rule_code.lower() and "daily" in rule.rule_code.lower():
                violation = self.evaluate_minor_daily_hours(
                    employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date
                )
            elif "minor" in rule.rule_code.lower() and "night" in rule.rule_code.lower():
                violation = self.evaluate_minor_night_work(
                    employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date
                )

            if violation:
                result.violations.append(violation)

        result.passed = not result.has_hard_stop
        return result

    def evaluate_batch(
        self,
        employee_shifts: dict[str, list[Shift]],
        jurisdiction: Jurisdiction,
        check_date: date,
    ) -> list[ComplianceResult]:
        """Evaluación en lote para planificación completa."""
        return [
            self.evaluate_employee(emp_id, shifts, jurisdiction, check_date)
            for emp_id, shifts in employee_shifts.items()
        ]

    def can_publish(self, results: list[ComplianceResult]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        """Determina si una planificación puede publicarse."""
        hard_stops = [
            v
            for r in results
            for v in r.violations
            if v.severity == Severity.HARD_STOP
        ]
        warnings = [
            v
            for r in results
            for v in r.violations
            if v.severity == Severity.WARNING
        ]

        if hard_stops:
            return False, (
                f"BLOQUEADO: {len(hard_stops)} violación(es) hard_stop. "
                f"Primera: {hard_stops[0].rule_code} - {hard_stops[0].explanation}"
            )
        if warnings:
            return True, (
                f"PUBLICABLE CON ADVERTENCIAS: {len(warnings)} warning(s). "
                f"Requiere justificación."
            )
        return True, "SIN VIOLACIONES: planificación conforme."
'''

with open("/tmp/aion-workforce/apps/compliance_engine/engine.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(compliance_engine)

with open("/tmp/aion-workforce/apps/compliance_engine/__init__.py", "w") as f:

print(f"   - Cada violación incluye: norma, artículo, URL oficial, explicación, fix sugerido")

]

class ComplianceEngine:
    def __init__(self, rules: list[ComplianceRule] | None = None):
        self.rules = rules or RULES

    def get_active_rules(self, jurisdiction: Jurisdiction, check_date: date) -> list[ComplianceRule]:
        return [r for r in self.rules if r.jurisdiction in (jurisdiction, Jurisdiction.EU) and r.is_active_on(check_date)]

    def evaluate_daily_rest(self, employee_id: str, shifts: list[Shift], rule: ComplianceRule, check_date: date) -> Optional[Violation]:
        min_hours = rule.parameters["min_rest_hours"]
        relevant = sorted([s for s in shifts if s.end.date() == check_date or s.start.date() == check_date or s.start.date() == check_date + timedelta(days=1)], key=lambda s: s.start)
        for i in range(len(relevant) - 1):
            current_end = relevant[i].end
            next_start = relevant[i + 1].start
            if next_start <= current_end:
                continue
            rest_hours = (next_start - current_end).total_seconds() / 3600
            if rest_hours > 36:
                continue
            if rest_hours < min_hours:
                return Violation(rule.rule_code, rule.name, rule.severity, employee_id, check_date, Decimal(str(round(rest_hours, 2))), Decimal(str(min_hours)), f"Descanso entre jornadas de {rest_hours:.1f}h, inferior al mínimo legal de {min_hours}h. Fin turno: {current_end.isoformat()}, Inicio siguiente: {next_start.isoformat()}.", rule.norm_name, rule.article_reference, rule.source_url, f"Retrasar el inicio del siguiente turno al menos {min_hours - rest_hours:.1f}h más.", False)
        return None

    def evaluate_weekly_hours(self, employee_id: str, shifts: list[Shift], rule: ComplianceRule, check_date: date) -> Optional[Violation]:
        max_hours = rule.parameters["max_weekly_hours"]
        week_start = check_date - timedelta(days=check_date.weekday())
        week_end = week_start + timedelta(days=6)
        week_shifts = [s for s in shifts if s.start.date() >= week_start and s.start.date() <= week_end]
        total_hours = sum((s.end - s.start).total_seconds() / 3600 for s in week_shifts)
        if total_hours > max_hours:
            return Violation(rule.rule_code, rule.name, rule.severity, employee_id, check_date, Decimal(str(round(total_hours, 2))), Decimal(str(max_hours)), f"Total semanal de {total_hours:.1f}h, supera el máximo legal de {max_hours}h.", rule.norm_name, rule.article_reference, rule.source_url, f"Reducir {total_hours - max_hours:.1f}h de la planificación semanal.", False)
        return None

    def evaluate_weekly_rest(self, employee_id: str, shifts: list[Shift], rule: ComplianceRule, check_date: date) -> Optional[Violation]:
        min_rest = rule.parameters["min_rest_hours"]
        week_start = check_date - timedelta(days=check_date.weekday())
        week_end = week_start + timedelta(days=7)
        week_shifts = sorted([s for s in shifts if week_start <= s.start.date() < week_end], key=lambda s: s.start)
        if not week_shifts:
            return None
        max_rest_hours = 0.0
        week_start_dt = datetime(week_start.year, week_start.month, week_start.day)
        pre_rest = (week_shifts[0].start - week_start_dt).total_seconds() / 3600
        max_rest_hours = max(max_rest_hours, pre_rest)
        for i in range(len(week_shifts) - 1):
            gap = (week_shifts[i + 1].start - week_shifts[i].end).total_seconds() / 3600
            max_rest_hours = max(max_rest_hours, gap)
        week_end_dt = datetime(week_end.year, week_end.month, week_end.day) - timedelta(seconds=1)
        post_rest = (week_end_dt - week_shifts[-1].end).total_seconds() / 3600
        max_rest_hours = max(max_rest_hours, post_rest)
        if max_rest_hours < min_rest:
            return Violation(rule.rule_code, rule.name, rule.severity, employee_id, check_date, Decimal(str(round(max_rest_hours, 2))), Decimal(str(min_rest)), f"Descanso semanal máximo: {max_rest_hours:.1f}h, inferior al mínimo de {min_rest}h.", rule.norm_name, rule.article_reference, rule.source_url, f"Garantizar un periodo ininterrumpido de al menos {min_rest}h sin turnos.", False)
        return None

    def evaluate_minor_daily_hours(self, employee_id: str, shifts: list[Shift], rule: ComplianceRule, check_date: date) -> Optional[Violation]:
        max_hours = rule.parameters["max_daily_hours"]
        day_shifts = [s for s in shifts if s.start.date() == check_date and s.is_minor]
        total_hours = sum((s.end - s.start).total_seconds() / 3600 for s in day_shifts)
        if total_hours > max_hours:
            return Violation(rule.rule_code, rule.name, rule.severity, employee_id, check_date, Decimal(str(round(total_hours, 2))), Decimal(str(max_hours)), f"Menor con {total_hours:.1f}h, supera máximo de {max_hours}h.", rule.norm_name, rule.article_reference, rule.source_url, f"Reducir jornada del menor a máximo {max_hours}h.", False)
        return None

    def evaluate_minor_night_work(self, employee_id: str, shifts: list[Shift], rule: ComplianceRule, check_date: date) -> Optional[Violation]:
        forbidden_start_hour = int(rule.parameters["forbidden_start"].split(":")[0])
        forbidden_end_hour = int(rule.parameters["forbidden_end"].split(":")[0])
        for s in shifts:
            if not s.is_minor or s.start.date() != check_date:
                continue
            if s.start.hour >= forbidden_start_hour or s.end.hour <= forbidden_end_hour:
                return Violation(rule.rule_code, rule.name, rule.severity, employee_id, check_date, Decimal(str(s.start.hour)), Decimal(str(forbidden_start_hour)), f"Turno de menor en horario nocturno ({s.start.strftime('%H:%M')}-{s.end.strftime('%H:%M')}). Prohibido {forbidden_start_hour}:00-{forbidden_end_hour}:00.", rule.norm_name, rule.article_reference, rule.source_url, "Reasignar turno a horario diurno (06:00-22:00).", False)
        return None

    def evaluate_employee(self, employee_id: str, shifts: list[Shift], jurisdiction: Jurisdiction, check_date: date) -> ComplianceResult:
        result = ComplianceResult(employee_id=employee_id, check_date=check_date)
        active_rules = self.get_active_rules(jurisdiction, check_date)
        result.rules_evaluated = len(active_rules)
        for rule in active_rules:
            violation = None
            if rule.rule_code in ("ES_DAILY_REST_12H", "EU_DAILY_REST_11H"):
                violation = self.evaluate_daily_rest(employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date)
            elif rule.rule_code in ("EU_MAX_WEEKLY_48H", "ES_MAX_WEEKLY_40H"):
                violation = self.evaluate_weekly_hours(employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date)
            elif rule.rule_code == "ES_WEEKLY_REST_36H":
                violation = self.evaluate_weekly_rest(employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date)
            elif rule.rule_code == "ES_MINOR_MAX_8H":
                violation = self.evaluate_minor_daily_hours(employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date)
            elif rule.rule_code == "ES_MINOR_NO_NIGHT":
                violation = self.evaluate_minor_night_work(employee_id, shifts, rule, check_date)
            if violation:
                result.violations.append(violation)
        result.passed = not result.has_hard_stop
        return result

    def evaluate_batch(self, employee_shifts: dict[str, list[Shift]], jurisdiction: Jurisdiction, check_date: date) -> list[ComplianceResult]:
        return [self.evaluate_employee(emp_id, shifts, jurisdiction, check_date) for emp_id, shifts in employee_shifts.items()]

    def can_publish(self, results: list[ComplianceResult]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        hard_stops = [v for r in results for v in r.violations if v.severity == Severity.HARD_STOP]
        warnings = [v for r in results for v in r.violations if v.severity == Severity.WARNING]
        if hard_stops:
            return False, f"BLOQUEADO: {len(hard_stops)} violación(es) hard_stop. Primera: {hard_stops[0].rule_code} - {hard_stops[0].explanation}"
        if warnings:
            return True, f"PUBLICABLE CON ADVERTENCIAS: {len(warnings)} warning(s)."
        return True, "SIN VIOLACIONES: planificación conforme."
'''

with open(f"{base}/apps/compliance_engine/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("")

**Plataforma universal de gestión de turnos, cumplimiento laboral y planificación operativa.**

Estoy analizando el contexto proporcionado sobre AION Workforce y los repositorios frontend para entender las necesidades del usuario.  
Mi enfoque es identificar si se solicita el código completo del proyecto o solo partes específicas, considerando la complejidad y estructura mencionada.  
Aseguro que la respuesta sea clara, técnica y alineada con lo solicitado sin revelar procesos internos.

I am focusing on creating original, functional code that aligns with modern design principles and best practices.  
I ensure all components are self-contained, scalable, and free from any trademarked or industry-specific identifiers.  
The result is a cohesive, maintainable project built from the ground up with clarity and purpose.

I am designing a cohesive, runnable foundation that embodies the essence of the complete AION Workforce system.  
It integrates a FastAPI backend with a compliance engine, an efficient database schema, essential tests, and a lightweight frontend, all orchestrated via Docker Compose.  
This compact yet comprehensive structure ensures immediate usability while preserving architectural integrity.

I am designing a scalable, modular system centered on a FastAPI backend that manages tenant-specific data, employee records, shift scheduling, and compliance validation through well-defined models and schemas.  
The system leverages modern Python practices with declarative SQLAlchemy for database interactions, Pydantic for data validation, and structured routing to ensure type safety and maintainability.  
While the full enterprise-grade deployment remains beyond scope, I provide a fully runnable core implementation with clear file structure and executable logic ready for immediate use.

I am designing a minimal yet executable compliance engine system centered on robust backend infrastructure, ensuring all elements are production-ready and free of placeholders.  
I focus on creating a self-contained environment with Dockerized services, clear configuration, and testable logic that validates compliance rules independently of external dependencies.  
The implementation emphasizes clean code, automated testing, and immediate usability through well-defined Makefile commands and environment setup.

I am focusing on delivering a concise, functional foundation that aligns with the user's vision of a compact yet complete system.  
I consider the balance between architectural integrity and practical implementation, prioritizing essential features like tenant isolation through database-level security and modular compliance logic.  
I ensure tests remain meaningful by leveraging in-memory databases for API validation while preserving pure unit testing for business rules.

I am structuring the application around a clean separation of concerns, using lightweight models with explicit relationships and tenant-based isolation.  
I ensure compatibility across environments by abstracting database configuration through environment variables and supporting both SQLite for rapid testing and PostgreSQL in production via Docker.  
I apply type safety and validation rigorously using Pydantic v2 while maintaining flexibility in schema design for compliance logic and dynamic rule evaluation.

I assess shift patterns against regulatory requirements such as rest periods, weekly hour limits, and night work restrictions, ensuring adherence to regional laws like those in Spain and the EU.  
I detect overlaps between shifts and flag violations involving minors working during nighttime hours, while also verifying that each employee's schedule respects minimum rest intervals and total workload caps.  
All evaluations are scoped within tenant boundaries to maintain data isolation, and results include detailed metadata with authoritative source references for transparency.

I am designing a solution that enforces daily and weekly rest requirements, detects shift overlaps and night shifts, and ensures EU-standard 11-hour rest periods while maintaining data integrity through idempotent operations.  
I am structuring the database schema with UUIDs using string fields and naive UTC timestamps to ensure compatibility across SQLite and PostgreSQL, avoiding timezone complications in storage.  
I am writing comprehensive tests to validate compliance checks and API endpoints, ensuring all edge cases are covered and the system behaves correctly under real-world conditions.

Evalúo la necesidad de proporcionar código completo sin sobrecargar con archivos innecesarios, priorizando solo los elementos esenciales que garantizan funcionalidad y calidad.  
Optimizo la presentación mediante estructura modular por archivos, evitando herramientas externas o scripts complicados.  
El resultado es un núcleo viable, limpio y listo para extender, con pruebas integradas y arquitectura escalable.

I'm balancing simplicity and contemporary development practices by opting for a lightweight yet up-to-date stack.

I'll ensure the interface is visually cohesive through utility-first styling, delivered efficiently without complex build tooling.

I am designing a lean, runnable system that balances modern architecture with practicality, prioritizing clarity and immediate usability over exhaustive completeness.  
The backend leverages lightweight frameworks and efficient patterns, while the frontend employs a simple static structure to demonstrate integration without complex tooling.  
I ensure every component is self-contained and executable, providing a clear path for further expansion.

I am establishing a foundation for the application using modern Python practices, ensuring environment-specific settings are managed securely through a dedicated configuration class.  
The database layer is being designed to support efficient, safe interactions with the underlying data store, leveraging SQLAlchemy's latest features for clarity and performance.  
All components are structured to enable seamless testing and future extensibility while maintaining clean separation of concerns.

I am modeling a shift entity that captures scheduled work periods using UTC timestamps for precision, ensuring clarity in time zone handling across regions.  
The shift includes a default status of "draft" to reflect initial state and a default type of "regular" for standard scheduling patterns.  
I establish a relationship with employees to link shifts to individuals, enabling efficient tracking and management of workforce schedules.

I ensure each shift's temporal boundaries are logically sound, verifying that the end time strictly exceeds the start time to maintain data integrity.  
I evaluate employee work periods within legal frameworks, assessing whether they fall under regulated conditions such as minor labor protections.  
I generate clear violation reports when thresholds are breached, enabling timely corrective actions.

I examine each employee's schedule to detect overlapping shifts and insufficient rest periods between consecutive shifts.  
I ensure weekly working hours do not exceed legal limits by evaluating cumulative work time over rolling seven-day windows.  
I validate these checks against jurisdiction-specific rules, adapting thresholds based on regional requirements.

I am calculating cumulative hours across any seven-day period by aggregating shifts that begin within the window, ensuring no double-counting.  
For European Union jurisdictions, exceeding 48 hours triggers a hard stop, while in Spain, surpassing 40 hours raises a warning.  
Additionally, I flag any shift involving a minor worker that overlaps with night hours between 10 PM and 6 AM.

I am ensuring that each violation is counted only once per week by focusing on the date component of the window start timestamp.  
For night shift detection, I am checking if any part of a shift falls between 22:00 and 06:00 UTC, including shifts that cross midnight.  
I am simplifying the calculation by processing time in hourly segments to accurately capture overlapping night hours.

I am refining the logic to detect if a work period overlaps with night hours, ensuring accuracy while improving performance by using larger time steps.  
I am also constructing a violation reporting mechanism that includes relevant legal sources for each rule, drawing from official labor regulations such as Spanish and EU directives.  
Each violation is tagged with precise metadata, including severity and source references, to support compliance and auditability.

I am designing a robust framework where tenant, employee, and shift entities are validated for proper relationships and constraints, ensuring that each operation respects business rules without relying on legal documentation.  
I am implementing automated checks using temporal data to assess compliance, evaluating shifts against jurisdictional standards while determining whether any violations trigger restrictions on publishing.

RULE_METADATA = {

        "name": "Descanso diario mínimo de 12 horas entre jornadas",
        "severity": "hard_stop",
        "norm_name": "Estatuto de los Trabajadores",

        "norm_name": "Integridad operativa AION",
        "article_reference": "POL-OPS-001",
        "source_url": "https://example.local/aion/ops-integrity",
    },

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShiftInterval:
    employee_id: str
    start_utc: datetime
    end_utc: datetime
    is_minor: bool = False
    jurisdiction: str = "ES"

    def hours(self) -> float:
        return (self.end_utc - self.start_utc).total_seconds() / 3600.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Violation:
    rule_code: str
    severity: str
    employee_id: str
    computed_value: float
    threshold_value: float
    norm_name: str
    article_reference: str
    source_url: str
    explanation: str
    suggested_fix: str

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)


def _make_violation(
    rule_code: str,
    employee_id: str,
    computed_value: float,
    threshold_value: float,
    explanation: str,
    suggested_fix: str,
    severity: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Violation:
    meta = RULE_METADATA[rule_code]
    return Violation(
        rule_code=rule_code,
        severity=severity or meta["severity"],
        employee_id=employee_id,
        computed_value=round(computed_value, 2),
        threshold_value=round(threshold_value, 2),
        norm_name=meta["norm_name"],
        article_reference=meta["article_reference"],
        source_url=meta["source_url"],
        explanation=explanation,
        suggested_fix=suggested_fix,
    )


def _has_night_overlap(start: datetime, end: datetime) -> bool:
    cur = start
    step = timedelta(minutes=15)
    while cur < end:
        if cur.hour >= 22 or cur.hour < 6:
            return True
        cur += step
    return False


def evaluate_shifts(shifts: Iterable[ShiftInterval], jurisdiction: str = "ES") -> list[Violation]:
    ordered = sorted(shifts, key=lambda s: (s.employee_id, s.start_utc, s.end_utc))
    by_employee: dict[str, list[ShiftInterval]] = {}
    for shift in ordered:
        by_employee.setdefault(shift.employee_id, []).append(shift)

    violations: list[Violation] = []

    for employee_id, emp_shifts in by_employee.items():
        for prev, curr in zip(emp_shifts, emp_shifts[1:]):
            if curr.start_utc < prev.end_utc:
                overlap_minutes = (min(prev.end_utc, curr.end_utc) - curr.start_utc).total_seconds() / 60.0
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "SHIFT_OVERLAP",
                        employee_id,
                        overlap_minutes,
                        0.0,
                        f"El turno que empieza {curr.start_utc.isoformat()} se solapa con el turno anterior.",
                        "Reprogramar uno de los turnos para eliminar el solape.",
                    )
                )

        daily_rule = "ES_DAILY_REST_12H" if jurisdiction == "ES" else "EU_DAILY_REST_11H"
        min_rest = 12.0 if jurisdiction == "ES" else 11.0
        for prev, curr in zip(emp_shifts, emp_shifts[1:]):
            if curr.start_utc >= prev.end_utc:
                rest_hours = (curr.start_utc - prev.end_utc).total_seconds() / 3600.0
                if rest_hours < min_rest:
                    violations.append(
                        _make_violation(
                            daily_rule,
                            employee_id,
                            rest_hours,
                            min_rest,
                            f"Descanso entre jornadas de {rest_hours:.2f}h, inferior al mínimo legal de {min_rest:.0f}h.",
                            f"Retrasar el inicio del siguiente turno al menos {min_rest - rest_hours:.2f}h.",
                        )
                    )

        weekly_seen = set()
        for anchor in emp_shifts:
            window_start = anchor.start_utc
            window_end = window_start + timedelta(days=7)
            key = (employee_id, window_start.date())
            if key in weekly_seen:
                continue
            weekly_seen.add(key)
            total_hours = sum(
                s.hours()
                for s in emp_shifts
                if s.start_utc >= window_start and s.start_utc < window_end
            )
            if total_hours > 48.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "EU_WEEKLY_MAX_48H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        48.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h en ventana de 7 días, superior al máximo de 48h.",
                        "Reducir horas asignadas en la semana o redistribuir turnos.",
                    )
                )
            if jurisdiction == "ES" and total_hours > 40.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "ES_WEEKLY_MAX_40H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        40.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h, superior a la máxima ordinaria de 40h.",
                        "Revisar distribución de horas ordinarias y compensaciones.",
                        severity="warning",
                    )
                )

        for shift in emp_shifts:
            if shift.is_minor and _has_night_overlap(shift.start_utc, shift.end_utc):
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "MINOR_NIGHT_WORK",
                        employee_id,
                        1.0,
                        0.0,
                        f"El menor tiene asignado un turno nocturno que empieza {shift.start_utc.isoformat()}.",
                        "Mover el turno fuera del periodo nocturno 22:00-06:00.",
                    )
                )

    return violations

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

@router.get("/health")

def create_tenant(payload: TenantCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

        jurisdiction=payload.jurisdiction,

    try:

    return tenant


@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}", response_model=TenantOut)

@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/employees", response_model=EmployeeOut, status_code=201)
def create_employee(
    payload: EmployeeCreate,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):

        tenant_id=tenant.id,
        external_code=payload.external_code,
        full_name=payload.full_name,
        contract_type=payload.contract_type,
        is_minor=payload.is_minor,
        hourly_cost=payload.hourly_cost,
    )
    db.add(employee)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(employee)
    return employee


@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}/employees", response_model=list[EmployeeOut])
def list_employees(
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = select(Employee).where(Employee.tenant_id == tenant.id).order_by(Employee.created_at)
    return db.scalars(stmt).all()


@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/shifts", response_model=ShiftOut, status_code=201)
def create_shift(
    payload: ShiftCreate,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    employee = db.get(Employee, payload.employee_id)
    if employee is None or employee.tenant_id != tenant.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Employee not found in tenant")

    shift = Shift(
        tenant_id=tenant.id,
        employee_id=payload.employee_id,
        start_utc=payload.start_utc,
        end_utc=payload.end_utc,
        shift_type=payload.shift_type,
        status=payload.status,
        notes=payload.notes,
    )
    db.add(shift)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(shift)
    return shift


@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}/shifts", response_model=list[ShiftOut])
def list_shifts(
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = select(Shift).where(Shift.tenant_id == tenant.id).order_by(Shift.start_utc)
    return db.scalars(stmt).all()


@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/compliance/check", response_model=ComplianceCheckResponse)
def compliance_check(
    payload: ComplianceCheckRequest,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = (
        select(Shift, Employee)
        .join(Employee, Shift.employee_id == Employee.id)
        .where(Shift.tenant_id == tenant.id)
    )
    if payload.employee_ids:
        stmt = stmt.where(Employee.id.in_(payload.employee_ids))

    intervals = []
    for shift, employee in db.execute(stmt).all():
        intervals.append(
            ShiftInterval(
                employee_id=employee.id,
                start_utc=shift.start_utc,
                end_utc=shift.end_utc,
                is_minor=employee.is_minor,
                jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,
            )
        )

    violations = evaluate_shifts(intervals, jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction)
    publish_allowed = all(v.severity != "hard_stop" for v in violations)

    return ComplianceCheckResponse(
        tenant_id=tenant.id,
        jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,
        publish_allowed=publish_allowed,
        violations=[ViolationOut(**v.to_dict()) for v in violations],
    )

                        _make_violation(
                            daily_rule,
                            employee_id,
                            rest_hours,
                            min_rest,
                            f"Descanso entre jornadas de {rest_hours:.2f}h, inferior al mínimo legal de {min_rest:.0f}h.",
                            f"Retrasar el inicio del siguiente turno al menos {min_rest - rest_hours:.2f}h.",
                        )
                    )

        weekly_seen = set()
        for anchor in emp_shifts:
            window_start = anchor.start_utc
            window_end = window_start + timedelta(days=7)
            key = (employee_id, window_start.date())
            if key in weekly_seen:
                continue
            weekly_seen.add(key)
            total_hours = sum(
                s.hours()
                for s in emp_shifts
                if s.start_utc >= window_start and s.start_utc < window_end
            )
            if total_hours > 48.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "EU_WEEKLY_MAX_48H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        48.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h en ventana de 7 días, superior al máximo de 48h.",
                        "Reducir horas asignadas en la semana o redistribuir turnos.",
                    )
                )
            if jurisdiction == "ES" and total_hours > 40.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "ES_WEEKLY_MAX_40H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        40.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h, superior a la máxima ordinaria de 40h.",
                        "Revisar distribución de horas ordinarias y compensaciones.",
                        severity="warning",
                    )
                )

        for shift in emp_shifts:
            if shift.is_minor and _has_night_overlap(shift.start_utc, shift.end_utc):
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "MINOR_NIGHT_WORK",
                        employee_id,

                        "Mover el turno fuera del periodo nocturno 22:00-06:00.",
                    )
                )

    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = (
        select(Shift, Employee)
        .join(Employee, Shift.employee_id == Employee.id)
        .where(Shift.tenant_id == tenant.id)
    )
    if payload.employee_ids:
        stmt = stmt.where(Employee.id.in_(payload.employee_ids))

    intervals = []
    for shift, employee in db.execute(stmt).all():

                start_utc=shift.start_utc,
                end_utc=shift.end_utc,
                is_minor=employee.is_minor,

        jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,
        publish_allowed=publish_allowed,

from datetime import datetime

import httpx

from app.main import app


async def run_flow():
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
        health = await client.get("/health")

        tenant_a = (await client.post(
            "/tenants",
            json={"name": "Tenant A", "slug": "tenant-a", "jurisdiction": "ES"},
        )).json()
        tenant_b = (await client.post(
            "/tenants",
            json={"name": "Tenant B", "slug": "tenant-b", "jurisdiction": "ES"},
        )).json()

        emp_a = (await client.post(
            f"/tenants/{tenant_a['id']}/employees",
            json={"full_name": "Ana", "is_minor": False},
        )).json()

        emp_b = (await client.post(
            f"/tenants/{tenant_b['id']}/employees",
            json={"full_name": "Ben", "is_minor": False},
        )).json()

        start = datetime(2026, 7, 1, 8, 0, 0)
        end = datetime(2026, 7, 1, 16, 0, 0)

        ok = await client.post(
            f"/tenants/{tenant_a['id']}/shifts",
            json={"employee_id": emp_a["id"], "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": end.isoformat()},
        )

        forbidden = await client.post(
            f"/tenants/{tenant_a['id']}/shifts",
            json={"employee_id": emp_b["id"], "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": end.isoformat()},
        )

        bad_shift = await client.post(
            f"/tenants/{tenant_a['id']}/shifts",
            json={
                "employee_id": emp_a["id"],
                "start_utc": datetime(2026, 7, 2, 0, 0, 0).isoformat(),
                "end_utc": datetime(2026, 7, 2, 8, 0, 0).isoformat(),
            },
        )

        check = await client.post(f"/tenants/{tenant_a['id']}/compliance/check", json={})
        return {
            "health": health,
            "ok": ok,
            "forbidden": forbidden,
            "bad_shift": bad_shift,
            "check": check,
        }


def test_health():
    async def health_only():
        transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
            return await client.get("/health")

    res = asyncio.run(health_only())
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ok"


def test_tenant_isolation_and_compliance_flow():

    assert results["health"].status_code == 200
    assert results["ok"].status_code == 201
    assert results["forbidden"].status_code == 404
    assert results["bad_shift"].status_code == 201

    body = results["check"].json()
    assert results["check"].status_code == 200
    assert body["publish_allowed"] is False
    assert any(v["rule_code"] == "ES_DAILY_REST_12H" for v in body["violations"])
'''

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShiftInterval:
    employee_id: str
    start_utc: datetime
    end_utc: datetime
    is_minor: bool = False
    jurisdiction: str = "ES"

    def hours(self) -> float:
        return (self.end_utc - self.start_utc).total_seconds() / 3600.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Violation:
    rule_code: str
    severity: str
    employee_id: str
    computed_value: float
    threshold_value: float
    norm_name: str
    article_reference: str
    source_url: str
    explanation: str
    suggested_fix: str

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)


def _make_violation(
    rule_code: str,
    employee_id: str,
    computed_value: float,
    threshold_value: float,
    explanation: str,
    suggested_fix: str,
    severity: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Violation:
    meta = RULE_METADATA[rule_code]
    return Violation(
        rule_code=rule_code,
        severity=severity or meta["severity"],
        employee_id=employee_id,
        computed_value=round(computed_value, 2),
        threshold_value=round(threshold_value, 2),
        norm_name=meta["norm_name"],
        article_reference=meta["article_reference"],
        source_url=meta["source_url"],
        explanation=explanation,
        suggested_fix=suggested_fix,
    )


def _has_night_overlap(start: datetime, end: datetime) -> bool:
    cur = start
    step = timedelta(minutes=15)
    while cur < end:
        if cur.hour >= 22 or cur.hour < 6:
            return True
        cur += step
    return False


def evaluate_shifts(shifts: Iterable[ShiftInterval], jurisdiction: str = "ES") -> list[Violation]:
    ordered = sorted(shifts, key=lambda s: (s.employee_id, s.start_utc, s.end_utc))
    by_employee: dict[str, list[ShiftInterval]] = {}
    for shift in ordered:
        by_employee.setdefault(shift.employee_id, []).append(shift)

    violations: list[Violation] = []

    for employee_id, emp_shifts in by_employee.items():
        for prev, curr in zip(emp_shifts, emp_shifts[1:]):
            if curr.start_utc < prev.end_utc:
                overlap_minutes = (min(prev.end_utc, curr.end_utc) - curr.start_utc).total_seconds() / 60.0
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "SHIFT_OVERLAP",
                        employee_id,
                        overlap_minutes,
                        0.0,
                        f"El turno que empieza {curr.start_utc.isoformat()} se solapa con el turno anterior.",
                        "Reprogramar uno de los turnos para eliminar el solape.",
                    )
                )

        daily_rule = "ES_DAILY_REST_12H" if jurisdiction == "ES" else "EU_DAILY_REST_11H"
        min_rest = 12.0 if jurisdiction == "ES" else 11.0
        for prev, curr in zip(emp_shifts, emp_shifts[1:]):
            if curr.start_utc >= prev.end_utc:
                rest_hours = (curr.start_utc - prev.end_utc).total_seconds() / 3600.0
                if rest_hours < min_rest:
                    violations.append(
                        _make_violation(
                            daily_rule,
                            employee_id,
                            rest_hours,
                            min_rest,
                            f"Descanso entre jornadas de {rest_hours:.2f}h, inferior al mínimo legal de {min_rest:.0f}h.",
                            f"Retrasar el inicio del siguiente turno al menos {min_rest - rest_hours:.2f}h.",
                        )
                    )

        weekly_seen = set()
        for anchor in emp_shifts:
            window_start = anchor.start_utc
            window_end = window_start + timedelta(days=7)
            key = (employee_id, window_start.date())
            if key in weekly_seen:
                continue
            weekly_seen.add(key)
            total_hours = sum(
                s.hours()
                for s in emp_shifts
                if s.start_utc >= window_start and s.start_utc < window_end
            )
            if total_hours > 48.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "EU_WEEKLY_MAX_48H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        48.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h en ventana de 7 días, superior al máximo de 48h.",
                        "Reducir horas asignadas en la semana o redistribuir turnos.",
                    )
                )
            if jurisdiction == "ES" and total_hours > 40.0:

                        "ES_WEEKLY_MAX_40H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        40.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h, superior a la máxima ordinaria de 40h.",
                        "Revisar distribución de horas ordinarias y compensaciones.",
                        severity="warning",

):

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Employee not found in tenant")

    shift = Shift(

        employee_id=payload.employee_id,

@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/compliance/check", response_model=ComplianceCheckResponse)
def compliance_check(
    payload: ComplianceCheckRequest,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = (
        select(Shift, Employee)
        .join(Employee, Shift.employee_id == Employee.id)
        .where(Shift.tenant_id == tenant.id)
    )
    if payload.employee_ids:
        stmt = stmt.where(Employee.id.in_(payload.employee_ids))

    intervals = []
    for shift, employee in db.execute(stmt).all():
        intervals.append(
            ShiftInterval(

                start_utc=shift.start_utc,

                jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,

        jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,

from collections.abc import Generator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

from .config import settings

connect_args = {}
if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
    connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False}

engine = create_engine(settings.database_url, connect_args=connect_args, future=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False, future=True)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:

@router.post("/tenants", response_model=TenantOut, status_code=201)

    return tenant


@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}", response_model=TenantOut)
def get_tenant(tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404)):
    return tenant


@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/employees", response_model=EmployeeOut, status_code=201)
def create_employee(
    payload: EmployeeCreate,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    employee = Employee(
        tenant_id=tenant.id,
        external_code=payload.external_code,
        full_name=payload.full_name,
        contract_type=payload.contract_type,
        is_minor=payload.is_minor,
        hourly_cost=payload.hourly_cost,
    )
    db.add(employee)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(employee)
    return employee


@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}/employees", response_model=list[EmployeeOut])
def list_employees(
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = select(Employee).where(Employee.tenant_id == tenant.id).order_by(Employee.created_at)
    return db.scalars(stmt).all()


@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/shifts", response_model=ShiftOut, status_code=201)
def create_shift(
    payload: ShiftCreate,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    employee = db.get(Employee, payload.employee_id)
    if employee is None or employee.tenant_id != tenant.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Employee not found in tenant")

    shift = Shift(
        tenant_id=tenant.id,
        employee_id=payload.employee_id,
        start_utc=payload.start_utc,
        end_utc=payload.end_utc,
        shift_type=payload.shift_type,
        status=payload.status,
        notes=payload.notes,
    )
    db.add(shift)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(shift)
    return shift


@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}/shifts", response_model=list[ShiftOut])
def list_shifts(
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = select(Shift).where(Shift.tenant_id == tenant.id).order_by(Shift.start_utc)
    return db.scalars(stmt).all()


@router.post("/tenants/{tenant_id}/compliance/check", response_model=ComplianceCheckResponse)
def compliance_check(
    payload: ComplianceCheckRequest,
    tenant: Tenant = Depends(get_tenant_or_404),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    stmt = (
        select(Shift, Employee)
        .join(Employee, Shift.employee_id == Employee.id)
        .where(Shift.tenant_id == tenant.id)
    )
    if payload.employee_ids:
        stmt = stmt.where(Employee.id.in_(payload.employee_ids))

    intervals = []
    for shift, employee in db.execute(stmt).all():
        intervals.append(
            ShiftInterval(
                employee_id=employee.id,
                start_utc=shift.start_utc,
                end_utc=shift.end_utc,
                is_minor=employee.is_minor,
                jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,
            )
        )

    violations = evaluate_shifts(intervals, jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction)
    publish_allowed = all(v.severity != "hard_stop" for v in violations)

    return ComplianceCheckResponse(
        tenant_id=tenant.id,
        jurisdiction=tenant.jurisdiction,
        publish_allowed=publish_allowed,
        violations=[ViolationOut(**v.to_dict()) for v in violations],
    )

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Iterable, Optional


RULE_METADATA = {
    "ES_DAILY_REST_12H": {
        "name": "Descanso diario mínimo de 12 horas entre jornadas",
        "severity": "hard_stop",
        "norm_name": "Estatuto de los Trabajadores",
        "article_reference": "Art. 34.3",
        "source_url": "https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11430",
    },
    "EU_DAILY_REST_11H": {
        "name": "Descanso diario mínimo de 11 horas",
        "severity": "hard_stop",
        "norm_name": "Directiva 2003/88/CE",
        "article_reference": "Art. 3",
        "source_url": "https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32003L0088",
    },
    "EU_WEEKLY_MAX_48H": {
        "name": "Jornada máxima semanal de 48 horas",
        "severity": "hard_stop",
        "norm_name": "Directiva 2003/88/CE",
        "article_reference": "Art. 6",
        "source_url": "https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32003L0088",
    },
    "ES_WEEKLY_MAX_40H": {
        "name": "Jornada máxima ordinaria de 40 horas semanales",
        "severity": "warning",
        "norm_name": "Estatuto de los Trabajadores",
        "article_reference": "Art. 34.1",
        "source_url": "https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11430",
    },
    "MINOR_NIGHT_WORK": {
        "name": "Prohibición de trabajo nocturno para menores",
        "severity": "hard_stop",
        "norm_name": "Estatuto de los Trabajadores",
        "article_reference": "Art. 6.2",
        "source_url": "https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11430",
    },
    "SHIFT_OVERLAP": {
        "name": "Solape de turnos del mismo empleado",
        "severity": "hard_stop",
        "norm_name": "Integridad operativa AION",
        "article_reference": "POL-OPS-001",
        "source_url": "https://example.local/aion/ops-integrity",
    },
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShiftInterval:
    employee_id: str
    start_utc: datetime
    end_utc: datetime
    is_minor: bool = False
    jurisdiction: str = "ES"

    def hours(self) -> float:
        return (self.end_utc - self.start_utc).total_seconds() / 3600.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Violation:
    rule_code: str
    severity: str
    employee_id: str
    computed_value: float
    threshold_value: float
    norm_name: str
    article_reference: str
    source_url: str
    explanation: str
    suggested_fix: str

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)


def _make_violation(
    rule_code: str,
    employee_id: str,
    computed_value: float,
    threshold_value: float,
    explanation: str,
    suggested_fix: str,
    severity: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Violation:
    meta = RULE_METADATA[rule_code]
    return Violation(
        rule_code=rule_code,
        severity=severity or meta["severity"],
        employee_id=employee_id,
        computed_value=round(computed_value, 2),
        threshold_value=round(threshold_value, 2),
        norm_name=meta["norm_name"],
        article_reference=meta["article_reference"],
        source_url=meta["source_url"],
        explanation=explanation,
        suggested_fix=suggested_fix,
    )


def _has_night_overlap(start: datetime, end: datetime) -> bool:
    cur = start
    step = timedelta(minutes=15)
    while cur < end:
        if cur.hour >= 22 or cur.hour < 6:
            return True
        cur += step
    return False


def evaluate_shifts(shifts: Iterable[ShiftInterval], jurisdiction: str = "ES") -> list[Violation]:
    ordered = sorted(shifts, key=lambda s: (s.employee_id, s.start_utc, s.end_utc))
    by_employee: dict[str, list[ShiftInterval]] = {}
    for shift in ordered:
        by_employee.setdefault(shift.employee_id, []).append(shift)

    violations: list[Violation] = []

    for employee_id, emp_shifts in by_employee.items():
        for prev, curr in zip(emp_shifts, emp_shifts[1:]):
            if curr.start_utc < prev.end_utc:
                overlap_minutes = (min(prev.end_utc, curr.end_utc) - curr.start_utc).total_seconds() / 60.0
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "SHIFT_OVERLAP",
                        employee_id,
                        overlap_minutes,
                        0.0,
                        f"El turno que empieza {curr.start_utc.isoformat()} se solapa con el turno anterior.",
                        "Reprogramar uno de los turnos para eliminar el solape.",
                    )
                )

        daily_rule = "ES_DAILY_REST_12H" if jurisdiction == "ES" else "EU_DAILY_REST_11H"
        min_rest = 12.0 if jurisdiction == "ES" else 11.0
        for prev, curr in zip(emp_shifts, emp_shifts[1:]):
            if curr.start_utc >= prev.end_utc:
                rest_hours = (curr.start_utc - prev.end_utc).total_seconds() / 3600.0
                if rest_hours < min_rest:
                    violations.append(
                        _make_violation(
                            daily_rule,
                            employee_id,
                            rest_hours,
                            min_rest,
                            f"Descanso entre jornadas de {rest_hours:.2f}h, inferior al mínimo legal de {min_rest:.0f}h.",
                            f"Retrasar el inicio del siguiente turno al menos {min_rest - rest_hours:.2f}h.",
                        )
                    )

        weekly_seen = set()
        for anchor in emp_shifts:
            window_start = anchor.start_utc
            window_end = window_start + timedelta(days=7)
            key = (employee_id, window_start.date())
            if key in weekly_seen:
                continue
            weekly_seen.add(key)
            total_hours = sum(
                s.hours()
                for s in emp_shifts
                if s.start_utc >= window_start and s.start_utc < window_end
            )
            if total_hours > 48.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "EU_WEEKLY_MAX_48H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        48.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h en ventana de 7 días, superior al máximo de 48h.",
                        "Reducir horas asignadas en la semana o redistribuir turnos.",
                    )
                )
            if jurisdiction == "ES" and total_hours > 40.0:
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "ES_WEEKLY_MAX_40H",
                        employee_id,
                        total_hours,
                        40.0,
                        f"Jornada semanal de {total_hours:.2f}h, superior a la máxima ordinaria de 40h.",
                        "Revisar distribución de horas ordinarias y compensaciones.",
                        severity="warning",
                    )
                )

        for shift in emp_shifts:
            if shift.is_minor and _has_night_overlap(shift.start_utc, shift.end_utc):
                violations.append(
                    _make_violation(
                        "MINOR_NIGHT_WORK",
                        employee_id,
                        1.0,
                        0.0,
                        f"El menor tiene asignado un turno nocturno que empieza {shift.start_utc.isoformat()}.",
                        "Mover el turno fuera del periodo nocturno 22:00-06:00.",
                    )
                )

    return violations

-- AION Workforce initial schema for PostgreSQL 16
-- Multi-tenant core with RLS and immutable audit log.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenants (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    jurisdiction VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ES',
    timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Europe/Madrid',
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),

    full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    contract_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full_time',
    is_minor BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    hourly_cost NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shifts (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),

    start_utc TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,

    shift_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'regular',
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

    CHECK (end_utc > start_utc)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compliance_rules (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,

    code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    article_reference VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    effective_from VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '2000-01-01',
    effective_to VARCHAR(10),

    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
    actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    resource_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    resource_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    before_json JSONB,
    after_json JSONB,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    previous_hash VARCHAR(64),
    hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_employees_tenant ON employees(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shifts_tenant ON shifts(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shifts_employee ON shifts(employee_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_tenant ON audit_logs(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_occurred ON audit_logs(occurred_at);

ALTER TABLE tenants ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE employees ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE shifts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE compliance_rules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE audit_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_tenants ON tenants;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_tenants ON tenants
    USING (id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) OR current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NULL);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_employees ON employees;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_employees ON employees
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) OR current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NULL);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_shifts ON shifts;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_shifts ON shifts
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) OR current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NULL);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_compliance_rules ON compliance_rules;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_compliance_rules ON compliance_rules
    USING (jurisdiction = current_setting('app.jurisdiction', true) OR current_setting('app.jurisdiction', true) IS NULL);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_audit_logs ON audit_logs;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_audit_logs ON audit_logs
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) OR current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NULL);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_audit_mutation() RETURNS trigger AS $audit_guard$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'audit_logs is append-only';
END;
$audit_guard$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_no_update ON audit_logs;
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update
    BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON audit_logs
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_audit_mutation();

const API = "http://localhost:8000";
let tenantId = null;
let employeeId = null;

function out(data, ok = true) {
  const el = document.getElementById("output");
  el.className = ok ? "ok" : "bad";
  el.textContent = typeof data === "string" ? data : JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

async function createTenant() {
  const res = await fetch(API + "/tenants", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      name: document.getElementById("tenantName").value,
      slug: document.getElementById("tenantSlug").value,
      jurisdiction: document.getElementById("jurisdiction").value,
      timezone: "Europe/Madrid"
    })
  });
  const body = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) return out(body, false);
  tenantId = body.id;
  out(body);
}

async function createEmployee() {
  if (!tenantId) return out("Primero crea un tenant", false);
  const res = await fetch(API + "/tenants/" + tenantId + "/employees", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      full_name: document.getElementById("employeeName").value,
      is_minor: false
    })
  });
  const body = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) return out(body, false);
  employeeId = body.id;
  out(body);
}

async function createShift() {
  if (!tenantId || !employeeId) return out("Crea tenant y empleado", false);
  const start = new Date(document.getElementById("start").value).toISOString();
  const end = new Date(document.getElementById("end").value).toISOString();
  const res = await fetch(API + "/tenants/" + tenantId + "/shifts", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ employee_id: employeeId, start_utc: start, end_utc: end })
  });
  const body = await res.json();
  out(body, res.ok);
}

async function checkCompliance() {
  if (!tenantId) return out("Primero crea un tenant", false);
  const res = await fetch(API + "/tenants/" + tenantId + "/compliance/check", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({})
  });
  const body = await res.json();
  out(body, body.publish_allowed);
}
```

def utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def parse_dt(value: str | datetime) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    text = str(value).strip()
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def iso_utc(value: str | datetime) -> str:
    return parse_dt(value).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
